QuestInfo.name: [Odium] There's Nobody Left
QuestInfo.0: #bWinnie#k, the last Constable to escape from the residential district, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Everything you saw in the residential district, and everyone you spoke to there, was part of an Angler Company ruse.
QuestInfo.2: Just as you learned the truth about the residential district, #rKaling#k invaded the laboratory.
